thread:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty ALERT -> Incident PAGER-4821 fired for service=redwood-inference-runtime-prod. High queue depth detected across q=hot-inference (>= 95th percentile threshold). Paging schedule: eng-oncall primary.

incident-bot: Incident created: PAGER-4821 | severity=high | symptom=queue_backlog_exhausting_capacity | owner=eng-oncall | runbook=/runbooks/autoscaler-queue-backlog.md

maya: Acked. I'm on it. :wave:

aj: I see the alert. Maya, do we have any recent deploys?

maya: No prod deploys in the last 30m. Metrics: queue depth spiked ~3750001100, pods stayed flat. Autoscaler metrics show scale decisions failing around 3750001125.

priya: Logs from scale-controller show repeated errors: `error creating node: quotaExceeded: Quota 'CPUS' exceeded for project` — looks like cloud quota hit when trying to provision nodes.

nate: That matches what I saw on infra dashboard — control plane returned 429s for nodepool API calls. Could be provider-side throttle or we've exhausted on-demand quota.

maya: Customer impact? Any 5xx spike?

ops-bot: Metric snapshot: latency_p50 +20ms, latency_p99 +1.2s, 5xx_rate rising from 0.2% -> 1.8% over last 10m, affected requests ~3.5% of total for the cluster. Affected tenants: edgestream-prod (elevated errors), analytics-batch (timeouts).

carla: Recreating: queue backlog caused downstream kv-cache pressure and head-of-line blocking on GPU workers. Some requests stuck waiting for KV warmup.

maya: Steps: 1) try manual burst: scale statefulset to +4 replicas; 2) if node provisioning blocked, route small fraction of traffic to us-west-2 fallback pool; 3) enable degraded model variant (quantized) to reduce memory/cold-start time.

aj: I'm on manual scaling. Running:

maya: ```
kubectl -n inference scale sts inference-gpu-workers --replicas=18
# if HPA present, we may need to disable it temporarily:
kubectl -n inference patch hpa inference-hpa --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/minReplicas","value":18}]'
```

aj: Ran the scale command at 3750001280. Kubernetes accepted, but node creation errors continue: `googleapi: Error 429: Rate Limit Exceeded`.

priya: Confirming provider console shows nodepool API returning 429 with `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED`. Requesting quota bump via infra ticket now.

nate: In parallel, let's reduce load: enable traffic-split to send 15% to fallback region eu-west-1 where capacity is available. Maya can you update routing policy?

maya: Doing traffic-split change via routing service. Pushed a canary 10% to eu-west-1 at 3750001375. Observability: error rate for hot-inference dropped from 1.8% -> 0.9% overall.

incident-bot: Note added: manual surge attempted, provider throttling preventing new nodes. Fallback routing engaged.

carla: Also toggled kv-cache eviction TTL to free memory on workers: set KV_CACHE_TTL=60s (was 300s). Expect reduced warmup overhead but potential higher miss rate.

aj: Quick patch to autoscaler config: reduce scale_up_cooldown to 10s and increase max_pending_pods to 12 to allow more aggressive pod creations once nodes available. Pushed at 3750001420.

priya: Infra replied to ticket: quota request in progress; preliminary approval may take 20-30m. They recommended temporarily borrowing capacity from our sandbox project; raising concern to security.

nate: If quota bump takes too long, we should evict non-critical workloads from this cluster. Anyone want to own eviction plan?

maya: I'll coordinate with product to ID lower-priority tenants. Starting eviction of batch/low-priority pods now.

aj: Manual evictions done for analytics-batch, frees ~12 CPUs. Node pressure reduced, scheduler scheduling pending pods again.

ops-bot: Post-action metrics: queue depth decreasing, backlog processing rate up 2.4x, 5xx_rate stabilized ~0.6%. Still above baseline but improving.

pagerduty-bot: PAGER-4821 acknowledged by maya. Escalation policy: waiting 12m before paging next responder if not resolved.

carla: Anything else for immediate mitigation? We should add an autoscaler guard: on 429 from provider, fallback to soft scale that uses spare reserved capacity pool. File ticket for autoscaler team.

nate: Agreed. I'll open ENG-1192 to track root cause (nodepool API throttling + insufficient reserved capacity) and assign to eng-infra + eng-runtime.

maya: Handoff: I'm going offline in 30m, handing to AJ for ongoing watch. AJ, summary: provider rate limit blocked node creation; we did manual pod scaling (partially effective), engaged fallback region, evicted low-priority workloads, tweaked autoscaler config, KV_CACHE TTL lowered. Monitoring for 30m.

aj: Taking over. I'll keep the incident channel updated every 10m. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Handoff recorded: from=maya to=aj at 3750001510.

priya: Infra notes: quota bump approved (soft) by provider at 3750001602; nodes should start provisioning. They'll continue to monitor for API rate-limit spikes.

aj: New nodes are coming up; pods entering Running at 3750001650. Queue processing catching up, backlog expected to clear in ~8m.

ops-bot: Final snapshot at 3750001715: queue depth down 68%, 5xx_rate back to 0.25%, latency returning to baseline. Affected tenants recovering.

aj: Marking incident as mitigated. Will keep watch for another hour then close. Postmortem: yes — assign to ENG-1192, timeline + root cause analysis + followups (reserved capacity policy, autoscaler 429 handling, routing fallback automation).

maya: Thanks team. Good job moving fast. :heart:

pagerduty-bot: PAGER-4821 status -> mitigated (ack still open). Please resolve in PD when you'd like.

carla: I'll draft a short incident summary for customer comms and drop it in #customer-success once PD resolved.

aj: Closing notes: no config changes to prod permanent configs except temporary HPA minReplicas; will revert after stability. Will file revert task.

incident-bot: Thread archived to incidents log at 3750001720.
